# {{ site.name }} — full content dump

> Personal site of Vladimir Ilievski (Vlad), data scientist and creator of iSquared. This file is the long-form companion to /llms.txt: same structure, but each entry includes a truncated plain-text body so an LLM agent can ingest the bulk of the site in a single fetch. Pages with heavy inline scripts (visualizations) are truncated more aggressively — fetch the canonical URL for the live, interactive version.

Bio, background, talks, and publications of the author. Data scientist by day, content creator by night; author of iSquared. Heavy interactive HTML page — fetch the canonical URL for the live version.
